Title: Email Sender
Description: Send every Umbraco email through an HTTP API (Azure Communication Services, Postmark, GOV.UK Notify) instead of SMTP.

Screenshots.Caption: Settings > Health Check > Services: the Email provider check passes with Postmark while Umbraco's SMTP check reports no SMTP host, so email goes out through the API alone.
The same check when the provider rejects the credentials: it names the provider and the problem and never shows the token.
